heading: Today
text: Some breaks of morning sun northeast, then mostly cloudy.  A rising chance of showers mid to late afternoon in Quebec and NY.  Highs in the low to mid 70s, a few upper 60s in NH.  Winds southeast, becoming south 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain and showers spreading east, locally heavy at times. A chance of a thunderstorm, more so south.  Mild.  Lows in the 50s east to near 60 west.  Winds south to southeast 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Morning showers, mostly from the Green Mountains east, tapering off.  A chance of afternoon showers, possibly a thunderstorm south, with some breaks of afternoon sun from the Green Mountains west.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s, except 75 to 80 in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.  Winds south 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, shifting to the west near 10 mph.
